description.value:
Requirement You are wielding or can draw a firearm.

When an encounter begins, you act first in the initiative order regardless of your roll, and you are never off-guard at the start of an encounter for not having rolled. If another creature has an effect granting the same benefit, compare Perception as normal to break the tie.
